decisions.rationale: The pay statement is illegible and the applicant has only about three months with this employer (NOA reflects a prior period), so income support is not clearly established despite the $89,546 NOA.
The $20,400 deposit from the applicant's mother is covered by a gift letter stating the borrower will repay it, so it is a loan and not an acceptable gift.
Evalu-Rapide Plus is not on the approved appraiser panel.
The letter states the applicant is within a six-month probationary period (start 2026-04-15) and no exception approval is on file.
GDS is about 37.4% but TDS is about 45.3%, marginally above 44%; an exception may be considered with a 714 score, and the repayable gift would add obligations.
